children: Succinct plans a mainnet deployment of its zero-knowledge Cross-Chain Verifier on Chainlink CCIP, with additional lanes to follow. The deployment extends ZK verification of Ethereum finality to mainnet cross-chain transfers, moving the verifier from testnet into live routing. Each lane that adopts the verifier checks Ethereum finality through succinct proofs instead of heavier on-chain verification.

For Chainlink CCIP, the integration adds a proof-based verification option that can reduce the cost of confirming Ethereum finality on cross-chain messages. For Succinct, mainnet lanes create a direct adoption channel for PROVE, since verification demand scales with transfer volume on the lanes that enable it. Rollout is incremental, so usage depends on how many lanes adopt the verifier and how much traffic they carry.

title: Chainlink: Succinct targets ZK Cross-Chain Verifier mainnet deployment on CCIP - By 12 Oct 2026
